item.name: ByDates
item.query: SELECT RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Hotel, RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Period AS AccountingDate, RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.TotalRoomsClosingBalance, -RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomsBlockedClosingBalance AS RoomsBlockedClosingBalance, RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.CounterClosingBalance, SalesTurnovers.SalesTurnover, SalesTurnovers.RoomsRentedTurnover, SalesTurnovers.BedsRentedTurnover, SalesTurnovers.AdditionalBedsRentedTurnover, SalesTurnovers.RoomRevenueTurnover, SalesTurnovers.ExtraBedRevenueTurnover, SalesTurnovers.GuestDaysTurnover, SalesTurnovers.GuestsCheckedInTurnover, SalesTurnovers.RoomsCheckedInTurnover, SalesTurnovers.BedsCheckedInTurnover, SalesTurnovers.AdditionalBedsCheckedInTurnover, SalesTurnovers.ResourceRevenueTurnover FROM AccumulationRegister.RoomInventory.BalanceAndTurnovers( BEGINOFPERIOD(&BeginOfPeriod, DAY), ENDOFPERIOD(&EndOfPeriod, DAY), DAY, RegisterRecordsAndPeriodBoundaries, Hotel = &Hotel OR &Hotel = &EmptyHotel) AS RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers LEFT JOIN AccumulationRegister.Sales.Turnovers( BEGINOFPERIOD(&BeginOfPeriod, DAY), ENDOFPERIOD(&EndOfPeriod, DAY), DAY, NOT IsCorrection AND Hotel = &Hotel OR &Hotel = &EmptyHotel) AS SalesTurnovers ON (SalesTurnovers.Period = RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Period) AND (SalesTurnovers.Hotel = RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Hotel)

item.name: ByServices
item.query: SELECT SalesTurnovers.Hotel, SalesTurnovers.Service.ServiceType AS ServiceType, SalesTurnovers.Service, SalesTurnovers.SalesTurnover FROM AccumulationRegister.Sales.Turnovers(BEGINOFPERIOD(&BeginOfPeriod, DAY), ENDOFPERIOD(&EndOfPeriod, DAY), PERIOD, NOT IsCorrection AND (Hotel = &Hotel OR &Hotel = &EmptyHotel)) AS SalesTurnovers

item.name: ByCustomers
item.query: SELECT CustomerTurnovers.Hotel, CustomerTurnovers.Customer.CustomerType AS CustomerType, CustomerTurnovers.Customer, CustomerTurnovers.SalesTurnover, CustomerTurnovers.RoomRevenueTurnover FROM AccumulationRegister.Sales.Turnovers(BEGINOFPERIOD(&BeginOfPeriod, DAY), ENDOFPERIOD(&EndOfPeriod, DAY), PERIOD, NOT IsCorrection AND (Hotel = &Hotel OR &Hotel = &EmptyHotel)) AS CustomerTurnovers

calculatedField.expression: CASE WHEN RoomsRentedTurnover<>0 And RoomRevenueTurnover<>0 Then cmRound(ISNULL(RoomRevenueTurnover/RoomsRentedTurnover, 0), 2) Else 0 End
